controls.b03_controls_after_the_dependency_fix: Marriott 2025, Marriott 2023 (withheld ALL_BRANCHES_REJECTED, whose B01 was already computed) and Paramount 2025 carry the same result_id as the 30-metric batch
controls.compared_with: each control's last recorded result - the 30-metric batch (5c89905a) or the targeted round (c7a49b98)

defects_the_runs_found_in_this_change.a_published_row_named_the_successor: the shared projector writes company['primary_cik'] into every published row and evidence row; only the withheld rows took the period's registrant. The first run's published FY2024 rows paired CIK 2041610 with the predecessor's accession. historical_projection now hands the projector the period's registrant; all 20 published FY2024 rows name 813828 and the twelve control rows are byte-identical.
defects_the_runs_found_in_this_change.a_withheld_b03_without_b01: once B03's refusal became a withheld result, its Run failed on HISTORICAL_RUN_RESULT_DEPENDENCY_SET_INCOMPLETE: the refusal comes before B01 is computed. The dependency is now withheld with the same reason.
defects_the_runs_found_in_this_change.the_primary_catalog_was_not_admitted: the first run over these years failed every metric on 'Request-ledger locator evidence is invalid': re-deriving a predecessor period reads the successor's catalog first, and that catalog was not among the pinned input's admitted sources. Fixed in historical_annual_input before any of the runs recorded here.
defects_the_runs_found_in_this_change.the_same_refusal_read_two_ways: Company Facts carried the approved amendment refusal as a withheld result and the zero-AI route failed the attempt, so FY2024 had withheld rows for B04 and no row at all for B01 or the six event metrics. The zero-AI route now withholds with the same reason code and category.

what_this_is: every metric of Paramount's FY2024 - the predecessor registrant's year, read from its own filings - run through the native historical Run, frozen, rendered to a public row and cold-read in a separate process; plus twelve controls from the successor's own year and Marriott's, which the change must not move.
